method: Direct codeword-span enumeration and individual integer-elimination ranks; no symmetry-orbit reduction
support_digest_format: SHA256 of concatenated 12-byte supports, each internally sorted, supports in lexicographic order
limitations: Does not yet lift candidates to all six-bit hyperplanes.
Does not yet compare full support sets with historical outputs.
Does not establish the six-bit count 210336.
Does not prove the classical binary-support coverage theorem.
